exposure: Implementation of a package of essential interventions (EIs) by healthcare professional associations
outcome: Use of essential interventions (EIs) for delivery and neonatal care
cohort: Women aged over 18 years who delivered at two urban tertiary hospitals in Nepal.
finding: The implementation of EIs showed minimal change for frequently used interventions, an increase for some rarely used interventions, but no improvement for others with low baseline use.
mod_finding: The timely administration of prophylactic antibiotics before cesarean delivery significantly increased from 0.0% to 94.0% at one hospital.
